decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the easternor western sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.

Condition : 6 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 7 - The proposed single storey rear extension would not harm the appearance opf the area or the living conditions of adjoining residents and is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Housing Extensions) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Demolition of existing conservatory and erection of single storey rear extension to dwellinghouse.
